$comment: THE SURFACE-READINESS LIST (epic cinatra#3155). A wave of the lifecycle-drawing driver program may drive only what the DEFAULT BRANCH ships. Every aspect a wave grounded and could NOT drive is recorded here, with the reason and, where there is one, the pull request that lands it — never stubbed, never approximated through a different control. scripts/design/__tests__/surface-readiness.test.mjs re-proves every entry against the tree on every run, so an entry that has become false (the control shipped) is a RED rather than a stale note: the list retires itself.

waves.summary: The eight in-conversation review cards for an individual artifact kind. Grounded one aspect at a time against the default branch: no first-party control carries either floor action the drawing declares, no per-kind card is drawn anywhere, and the per-kind readings that do exist are drawn inside the review card's credentialed island frame. The wave therefore adds no driver and records what each aspect is waiting for.

entries.why: The email body kind registers no artifact display on the default branch: its package declares field renderers for the mid-run form and no display block at all, so nothing draws this binding for a reviewer to read.

No first-party module carries a control for this action. The review floor's Continue is landing on pull request 3100, which ships the attribute for exactly this action-and-outcome pair, so the wave after that landing drives this surface rather than approximating it through another control.

No first-party module draws a card for this artifact kind at all: the surface's conformance anchor appears in the manifest and nowhere else in the tree. Until something draws the surface, its readings have nothing to be states of.

Every per-kind reading of a review target is drawn by a SERVER component inside the review card's own credentialed island frame, which the card addresses through a single-use, authorised URL. A props-only harness mount cannot reach it, and this harness substitutes no transport of any kind.

What the drawing adds and the product does not have is a card that SAYS so where a reader can see it.
